# A call omitting a defaulted argument, run on the interpreter, in a browser
# and on bubbletea: a package function's, and a component method's whose
# default reads the component's own state. testdata/func_default_argument.txtar
# is the code on all five targets.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var n = 1

func plus(k int, by int = 2) int {
    return k + by + n
}

component counter ui.node {
    var step = 2
    var total = 0

    func add(a int = 1, by int = step * 3) {
        total += a + by
    }

    ui.button #b(text="{total}", @click {
        add()
    })
}

func testOmittedDefaults(t Test, c counter) {
    t.assert(plus(1) == 4)
    c.b.click()
    t.assert(c.total == 7)
}

ui.window {
    counter()
}
